title: Above peer-group average
brief: Compare each product against its own peer group.
instructions: Return products strictly above their own category exact average. Singleton and equal-price categories contribute no row. Do not round the average.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes product_id,category_id,unit_price from products without solving above peer-group average.

hints.text: Correlate the comparison population by category identity.
Compare product price times its peer count against its peer sum.
Category 3 has two equal prices; category 2 has distinct prices.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT unit_price) FROM products WHERE category_id = 3)::VARCHAR || '/' || (SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = 3)::VARCHAR || '/' || (SELECT count(DISTINCT unit_price) FROM products WHERE category_id = 2)::VARCHAR || '/' || (SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = 2)::VARCHAR
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: category 3 has two equal prices and category 2 has distinct prices
